notes.title: FlopHop in Japan! Tokyo Indie Games Summit 2025 [DevDiary №8]
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=hnCIm3ZOPVU;full][/previewyoutube]

In this DevDiary I share my experience attending the Tokyo Indie Games Summit 2025, where Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop was showcased. I talk about the summit, the vibrant indie game scene in Japan, and the exciting opportunities it offered for developers. Plus, I give a glimpse into Japan's unique aura and share some highlights from the event!

notes.title: Tokyo Indie Games Summit 2025 with FlopHop
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046878/246baf3a21a4e45255d2ce16c6a4eee1b9c16a1d.png[/img]

Heading to T[url=https://indiegamessummit.tokyo/en/]okyo for the Indie Games Summit[/url] to present Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop! I’m beyond excited that it was selected for the event. This major event is happening on March 8–9, and I’m honored to be part of it. I’ll have my very own FlopHop booth - number RO-3a - at the Kichijoji Tokyu REI Hotel. You’ll be able to play the game, chat with me, and even grab some merch - including handmade items! It promises to be an exciting event, and I’ll definitely dedicate a separate gamedev diary entry to share all about it.
Mata ne!

notes.title: One Year of FlopHop Development
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=IVnbAZIxUO8;full][/previewyoutube]

November 14, 2023, was the day I made my very first commit for FlopHop. Today, I’m celebrating one year of development — a perfect time to delve into the world of FlopHop and share some exciting plans for the future.
Thanks for your support! Subscribe and watch more DevDiaries everybunnyːwinterbunny2023ː

notes.title: Steam Next Fest is just around the corner!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3134890/Bunny_Space_Odyssey_FlopHop_Demo/?beta=1]The Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop Demo[/url] is featured in Steam Next Fest this week, making it the perfect opportunity to give it a try if you haven't already!

We're thrilled to introduce the latest update: the quest log has been added, guiding our bunny Ponchee through her current tasks. It’s such a joy to share the story of FlopHop with you, and your feedback has been invaluable! We love seeing your videos and articles about the game. So keep going!

The game is scheduled for release in 2025, but if FlopHop has resonated with you, you can support its development by purchasing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3148460/Bunny_Space_Odyssey_FlopHop_Demo_Soundtrack/]the FlopHop Soundtrack Album[/url], which features the music that sets the tone for the demo

Hoppy Steam Next Fest to everybunn!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046878/a8c2df5d89a781bfa9377fadca1ea82d7e3de3a0.png[/img]

notes.title: FlopHop Demo Release: First Week and Three Updates!
notes.notes:
It’s been a week since the demo release, and you can play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3134890/Bunny_Space_Odyssey_FlopHop_Demo/?beta=1]it right HERE[/url]!
Over this week, we’ve released three updates thanks to your feedback and suggestions. We’re not planning to stop, and we hope the game will keep getting better.

It’s so exciting that you’re diving into Ponchee’s story and exploring the planet FlopHop. Every moment you spend in this world means so much to us. Your feedback and support are what make this journey possible, and we’re so happy to have you along for the ride. 

Thanks to everybunny!
